files.docs/design.md:
# Plugin system

Rules move out of the core into plugins.
A plugin exports a manifest and a list of rules.
Each rule receives the parsed migration and returns findings.
The host loads plugins listed in migralint.config.json.

files.docs/sandbox.md:
# Plugin sandbox

## Isolation choice

vm contexts share the event loop with the host, so a plugin rule stuck in a loop freezes the whole lint run.
Worker threads can be terminated from the host after a timeout, so we run rules in workers instead.

events.ref: chat 2026-03-09: approved moving the plugin sandbox to worker threads

events.why: One table at the end lets users fix every broken plugin in one pass instead of rerunning after each error.

files.docs/cache.md:
# Cache

Parsed ASTs and rule results live in .migralint/cache.
AST entries are keyed by file hash only.
Rule result entries also carry a hash of migralint.config.json, so a config edit only misses results.
Nothing is deleted on config change; old entries age out.
